The 2018 Azerbaijan Grand Prix (round 4, Baku City Circuit, 29 April 2018) was won by Lewis Hamilton driving for Mercedes. He started from second on the grid. Kimi Räikkönen (Ferrari) finished second and Sergio Pérez (Force India) third.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
